item.title: Verstappen’s criticism “valid” but don’t judge new rules too quickly, says Russell | Formula 1
item.description: George Russell urged rivals to "stay open-minded" about Formula 1's 2026 rules after Max Verstappen criticised the new generation of cars.

item.title: Catalunya to share F1 race slot with Spa in new deal running to 2032 | Formula 1
item.description: The Circuit de Catalunya in Spain will share a Formula 1 calendar slot with Belgium's Spa-Francorchamps circuit in a new deal announced today by the series.

item.title: Round-up: McLaren team orders added unnecessary “stress” says Piastri, and more | RaceFans Round-up
item.description: Tuesday's edition of the RaceFans round-up.

item.title: ‘It pains me to hear ‘we’ll get back to you” – Smedley on Hamilton’s radio frustrations | Formula 1
item.description: Former Ferrari race engineer Rob Smedley says he was "pained" by some of last year's radio exchanges between Lewis Hamilton and Ricardo Adami.

item.title: Round-up: “Ferrari seem to be able to run higher gears” says Russell and more | Formula 1
item.description: Also in Wednesday's edition of the RaceFans round-up, Liberty Media's effort to move Moto GP's Australian round to Melboune has been blocked.

item.title: Leclerc quickest for Ferrari but Red Bull miss out on mileage as final test begins | Formula 1
item.description: Charles Leclerc was quickest as testing resumed in Bahrain but Red Bull managed only 13 laps over the first four hours.

item.title: FIA plans to tackle F1 power unit row by introducing new rule at summer break | Formula 1
item.description: The FIA has devised a new test to ensure engines comply with compression ratio limits but will not introduce it before the second half of the season.

item.title: No immediate, major change to 2026 car rules after drivers’ criticism – FIA | Formula 1
item.description: "No immediate major regulatory changes" are needed despite Formula 1 drivers' criticism of the new cars, says the FIA.

item.title: Russell pips Piastri on day one as F1 tests revised starting procedure | Formula 1
item.description: George Russell led Oscar Piastri by a 0.01 seconds in the first day of the final test and drivers tried the FIA's new race start procedure.

item.title: Pictures: 2026 F1 pre-season test three day one: Bahrain | F1 pictures
item.description: Pictures from the first day of the third test for the 2026 F1 season at the Bahrain International Circuit. This gallery will be updated throughout the day.
